notes.title: 0.5.0 Update available
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653078/287675f75f16448033fe062827cf8eddfd2c82ea.jpg

Changes list:
.
 Diseases added. Now you can get a disease with some debuff. Diseases can be cured on medical stations.
 Added Med Boosters. You can buy a med-booster on a medical station to improve player/crew.
 2 classes added to turn-based crew combat (4vs4).
 Crew now receive separate experience and skill bonuses.
 Some research items are now dropped from Pbots and Warants ships (demo version not affected).
 Quests added
 Text changes in quests
 Faction statuses added. Factions can now confront each other. Statuses added: "Cold War", "Spy War", "Trade Ban", "Cooperation".


Many, many other changes. You can check them. Please create a new character and a new game as the new version does not support old saves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653078/c9ccdf60dccaf423dc6eb8c40b29dcb8a36bfff3.png

notes.title: 0.3.7 update available
notes.notes:
Changes list:

 Tutorials added. Now the game mechanics should be easier to understand.
 Added passenger/prisoner missions. Now you can accept/complete mission by transport passenger or prisoner if your ship has corresponding spaces.
 You can now select crew positions before crew combat.
 Crew equipment now shows detailed info.
 Storage panel added. Now you can check on which planet you are storing your equipment/goods.
 Minor price adjustments.
 Many bug and typo fixes.


Thanks to RedWolfik for feedback/playtest.

notes.title: Devlog update - 20.10.23
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653078/d6c4416452a0d77851c34857fd41e71083f63bb0.gif


 Reworked the side quest system a bit. Nothing has changed visually, but it will now be easier for me to translate side quests text into other languages.
 Improved the logic of merchants' lives. Now merchants actually buy goods on planets. Then they look for places to sell those goods - and then they go, sell the goods, make a profit, and upgrade their ship when they have a surplus of money.
 Due to the fact that merchants now transport goods - the player can now share those goods - "extortion".
 Finally, the hangar has been completed. Now the player can see what other ships are in the hangar and scan them even if the scanner power is low.
 If a pirate has destroyed several peaceful ships or is transporting contraband, he will go to jail when he lands on a planet. We can even see a message in the hangar that this ship is currently under arrest.
 When building ships - pilots get skill bonuses depending on the class of the ship. Merchants are better at trading, pirates are better at attacking. Soldiers have a dodge skill bonus. 
 Added unique music for stations.
 When hovering over skills - the player can now see what exactly that skill improves.
 Finished the system of extortion from trade ships (and not only). Player can demand money or goods.
 Introduced a new item in the ship dialog - "Help me fight someone". Pirates will not help in a fight with pirates, and merchants will not attack other merchants.
 The icons of all equipment, weapons, goods, etc. have been significantly redesigned. Now it is not only monochrome poorly drawn icons, but more realistic and colored icons.
 Added names for all equipment, weapons, hulls. Now each new level of equipment has its own prefix to the name. For example, "Resonance Cannon" or "Pamiar Engine" or "Titanium Hull".
 Charisma effects now increase the reward for a task and give a bonus to the attitude of others.
 Tech skill now affects the maximum number of search probes available.
 Players can now hire other rangers for a fee for a limited period of time. Better equipped rangers will charge a higher fee for such a contract.
 The hiring logic has been reworked slightly. Partners are less likely to lose their "leader" and will land on the same planets as the employer to refuel and sell stuff instead of just waiting in orbit.

notes.title: Devlog update - 22.09.23
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653078/b3a34e6fc749e9ab6d9adcf64351d1625de62b8f.png


 Players can now buy maps of galaxy sectors on planets. This action will open a new region on the galaxy map. 
 Military station: funding the liberation mission. Now you can fund military liberation of captured star systems.
 Medical station: Heal crew. Crew members who are losing health points can be healed at the medical station for some money.
 Pirate station: Plastic surgery (change your face). Visit the Pirate Station to change your face and race. This should help you if some governments are hunting you.
 Science Station: Buy a probe. The science station will sell you a probe that will help you to search for items on uninhabited planets.
 Science Station: Upgrade your equipment. You can also upgrade your equipment at the science station. 
For a small fee, engineers will improve your engine, weapon or other equipment. I highly recommend using this feature.
 Change screen resolution and window mode. You can now change your screen resolution and switch to windowed mode.
 Create two end game bosses. Now we can complete the game. Eey. 
 Created the first 9 tutorial missions. These are basic missions that will help you learn the basics of the game. Like shooting, grabbing, jumping into systems, buying and selling goods, talking and so on.
 Equipment degradation. Now all ship equipment decreases its hp while working. For example, guns lose hp when shooting, grabs - when grabbing items, radar - all the time.
 Added ability to repair equip on planet/station for money. When equipment is detected - we should be able to repair it, right? We can do it on planets and stations.
